investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Cedarvid Games (online gaming); Platform: AWS ap-southeast-1 (zones ap-southeast-1a/ap-southeast-1b/ap-southeast-1c); network range 10.207.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster cedarv-prod-apsout (EKS); store-api pods run with 2 GiB memory limits; deployments are canary releases with automated analysis; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
